-- Workspaces
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspaces (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Users
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Memberships
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS memberships (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  workspace_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'member', 'viewer')),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  CONSTRAINT uq_membership_workspace_user UNIQUE (workspace_id, user_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_memberships_workspace ON memberships(workspace_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_memberships_user ON memberships(user_id);

-- Sessions
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  workspace_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  last_active_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_token_hash ON sessions(token_hash);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_workspace ON sessions(workspace_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_user ON sessions(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_active ON sessions(expires_at, revoked_at);

-- Audit Events (Immutable ledger)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_events (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  workspace_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  actor_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  action TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_id TEXT,
  payload JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_events_workspace ON audit_events(workspace_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_events_created_at ON audit_events(workspace_id, created_at DESC);

-- Idempotency Keys
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency_keys (
  key TEXT NOT NULL,
  workspace_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  request_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('in_progress', 'completed', 'failed')),
  response_status INTEGER,
  response_body JSONB,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, key)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_idempotency_keys_expires ON idempotency_keys(expires_at);

-- Approval Requests
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS approval_requests (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  workspace_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  action_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  action_params JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  requester_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  approver_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'claimed', 'approved', 'rejected', 'expired', 'executed', 'execution_failed')),
  risk_level TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (risk_level IN ('low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical')),
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_approval_requests_workspace ON approval_requests(workspace_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_approval_requests_status ON approval_requests(workspace_id, status);

-- Job Runs
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_runs (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  workspace_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  job_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed', 'retrying')),

  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

-- 7. SECURITY DEFINER helpers for authentication scope resolution
-- Resolves session token hash to scope tuple without unscoped table reads
-- Search path is pinned to (pg_catalog, public) with fully qualified table references
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION resolve_session_scope(p_token_hash TEXT)
RETURNS TABLE (
  session_id UUID,
  workspace_id UUID,
  user_id UUID,
  role TEXT,
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ
)
LANGUAGE sql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $$
  SELECT s.id, s.workspace_id, s.user_id, m.role, s.expires_at
  FROM public.sessions s
  INNER JOIN public.memberships m ON m.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND m.user_id = s.user_id
  WHERE s.token_hash = p_token_hash
    AND s.revoked_at IS NULL
    AND s.expires_at > NOW();
$$;

-- Retrieves memberships strictly for an authenticated user verified by email
-- Narrowed to prevent general tenant/membership enumeration or privilege escalation
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_authenticated_user_memberships(p_user_id UUID, p_email TEXT)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id UUID,
  workspace_id UUID,
  user_id UUID,
  role TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ
)
LANGUAGE sql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $$
  SELECT m.id, m.workspace_id, m.user_id, m.role, m.created_at, m.updated_at
  FROM public.memberships m
  INNER JOIN public.users u ON u.id = m.user_id
  WHERE m.user_id = p_user_id
    AND u.email = p_email;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pg_temp.assert_trigger(
  p_table TEXT,
  p_trigger_name TEXT,
  p_proc_name TEXT
)
RETURNS VOID
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_found BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
  SELECT TRUE INTO v_found
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger tr
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class cl ON tr.tgrelid = cl.oid
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON cl.relnamespace = n.oid
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc p ON tr.tgfoid = p.oid
  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
    AND cl.relname = p_table
    AND tr.tgname = p_trigger_name
    AND p.proname = p_proc_name
    AND NOT tr.tgisinternal;

  IF NOT FOUND OR v_found IS NOT TRUE THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Architectural Migration Failure: Required trigger % on public.% calling % is missing', p_trigger_name, p_table, p_proc_name;
  END IF;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pg_temp.assert_trigger(
  p_table TEXT,
  p_trigger_name TEXT,
  p_proc_name TEXT
)
RETURNS VOID
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_found BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
  SELECT TRUE INTO v_found
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger tr
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class cl ON tr.tgrelid = cl.oid
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON cl.relnamespace = n.oid
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc p ON tr.tgfoid = p.oid
  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
    AND cl.relname = p_table
    AND tr.tgname = p_trigger_name
    AND p.proname = p_proc_name
    AND NOT tr.tgisinternal;

  IF NOT FOUND OR v_found IS NOT TRUE THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Architectural Migration Failure: Required trigger % on public.% calling % is missing', p_trigger_name, p_table, p_proc_name;
  END IF;
END;
$$;

-- Function 1: insert_system_default_memory
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.insert_system_default_memory(
  p_workspace_id UUID,
  p_category TEXT,
  p_key TEXT,
  p_value TEXT,
  p_confidence NUMERIC DEFAULT 1.0,
  p_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS UUID
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_id UUID;
BEGIN
  -- Safe caller-boundary verification:
  -- 1) In PostgreSQL SECURITY DEFINER, CURRENT_USER is function owner.
  -- 2) Invocation authorization is strictly enforced via EXECUTE grant to role thaara_seeder.
  -- 3) Runtime verification confirms login SESSION_USER possesses membership in thaara_seeder.
  IF NOT pg_catalog.pg_has_role(SESSION_USER, 'thaara_seeder', 'MEMBER') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Permission denied: session_user "%" lacks thaara_seeder membership', SESSION_USER;
  END IF;

  -- Validate workspace exists
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.workspaces WHERE id = p_workspace_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Referenced workspace % does not exist', p_workspace_id;
  END IF;

  -- Validate bounded inputs
  IF p_category NOT IN ('preference', 'fact', 'guideline', 'decision') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid memory category: %', p_category;
  END IF;
  IF p_key IS NULL OR pg_catalog.length(pg_catalog.trim(p_key)) = 0 OR pg_catalog.length(p_key) > 255 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Memory key must be non-empty and at most 255 characters';
  END IF;
  IF p_value IS NULL OR pg_catalog.length(pg_catalog.trim(p_value)) = 0 OR pg_catalog.length(p_value) > 16384 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Memory value must be non-empty and at most 16384 characters';
  END IF;
  IF p_confidence IS NULL OR p_confidence < 0.0 OR p_confidence > 1.0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Memory confidence must be between 0.0 and 1.0';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.memory_items (
    workspace_id,
    scope,
    user_id,
    category,
    key,
    value,
    confidence,
    consent_status,
    consent_actor_user_id,
    consented_at,
    revoked_at,
    provenance,
    provenance_conversation_id,
    provenance_message_id,
    provenance_user_id,
    lifecycle_status,
    version,
    superseded_by_id,
    expires_at
  ) VALUES (
    p_workspace_id,
    'workspace',
    NULL,
    p_category,
    trim(p_key),
    trim(p_value),
    p_confidence,
    'pending_consent',
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    'system_default',
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    'active',
    1,
    NULL,
    p_expires_at
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_id;

  RETURN v_id;
END;
$$;

-- Function 4: supersede_memory_item
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.supersede_memory_item(
  p_session_token_hash TEXT,
  p_predecessor_id UUID,
  p_new_value TEXT,
  p_new_confidence NUMERIC DEFAULT 1.0,
  p_provenance TEXT DEFAULT 'explicit_user_input',
  p_provenance_conversation_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
  p_provenance_message_id UUID DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS UUID
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_session_id UUID;
  v_workspace_id UUID;
  v_user_id UUID;
  v_role TEXT;
  v_predecessor RECORD;
  v_successor_id UUID := pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid();
BEGIN
  -- Authenticate through session token hash
  SELECT s.session_id, s.workspace_id, s.user_id, s.role
  INTO v_session_id, v_workspace_id, v_user_id, v_role
  FROM public.resolve_session_scope(p_session_token_hash) s;

  IF v_workspace_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required or invalid session token';
  END IF;

  -- Validate inputs
  IF p_new_value IS NULL OR length(trim(p_new_value)) = 0 OR length(p_new_value) > 16384 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'New memory value must be non-empty and at most 16384 characters';
  END IF;
  IF p_new_confidence IS NULL OR p_new_confidence < 0.0 OR p_new_confidence > 1.0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Confidence must be between 0.0 and 1.0';
  END IF;
  IF p_provenance NOT IN ('explicit_user_input', 'conversation_message') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid provenance for user supersession: %', p_provenance;
  END IF;

  -- Lock predecessor
  SELECT *
  INTO v_predecessor
  FROM public.memory_items
  WHERE id = p_predecessor_id AND workspace_id = v_workspace_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Predecessor memory item % not found in authenticated workspace', p_predecessor_id;
  END IF;

  IF v_predecessor.lifecycle_status <> 'active' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot supersede non-active memory item (status is %)', v_predecessor.lifecycle_status;
  END IF;

  -- Authorization
  IF v_predecessor.scope = 'user' THEN
    IF v_predecessor.user_id <> v_user_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Permission denied: cannot supersede another user''s memory';
    END IF;
  ELSIF v_predecessor.scope = 'workspace' THEN
    IF v_role NOT IN ('owner', 'admin') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Permission denied: workspace memory supersession requires owner or admin role';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Validate message provenance if specified
  IF p_provenance = 'conversation_message' THEN
    IF p_provenance_conversation_id IS NULL OR p_provenance_message_id IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'conversation_message provenance requires both conversation_id and message_id';
    END IF;
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.conversation_messages
      WHERE workspace_id = v_workspace_id
        AND conversation_id = p_provenance_conversation_id
        AND id = p_provenance_message_id
        AND user_id = v_user_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Referenced message does not exist or does not belong to the authenticated user';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Insert successor first (deferred FK allows predecessor to point to successor)
  INSERT INTO public.memory_items (
    id,
    workspace_id,
    scope,
    user_id,
    category,
    key,
    value,
    confidence,
    consent_status,
    consent_actor_user_id,
    consented_at,
    revoked_at,
    provenance,
    provenance_conversation_id,
    provenance_message_id,
    provenance_user_id,
    lifecycle_status,
    version,
    superseded_by_id,
    expires_at
  ) VALUES (
    v_successor_id,
    v_workspace_id,
    v_predecessor.scope,
    v_predecessor.user_id,
    v_predecessor.category,
    v_predecessor.key,
    trim(p_new_value),
    p_new_confidence,
    'pending_consent',
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    p_provenance,
    p_provenance_conversation_id,
    p_provenance_message_id,
    CASE WHEN p_provenance = 'conversation_message' THEN v_user_id ELSE NULL END,
    'active',
    v_predecessor.version + 1,
    NULL,
    v_predecessor.expires_at
  );

  -- Mark predecessor superseded
  UPDATE public.memory_items
  SET lifecycle_status = 'superseded',
      superseded_by_id = v_successor_id,
      updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
  WHERE id = p_predecessor_id;

  -- Audit event
  INSERT INTO public.audit_events (
    workspace_id,
    actor_user_id,
    action,
    target_type,
    target_id,
    payload
  ) VALUES (
    v_workspace_id,
    v_user_id,
    'memory.superseded',
    'memory_item',
    v_successor_id::text,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'predecessor_id', p_predecessor_id,
      'successor_id', v_successor_id,
      'category', v_predecessor.category,
      'key', v_predecessor.key,
      'new_version', v_predecessor.version + 1
    )
  );

  RETURN v_successor_id;
END;
$$;

-- Function 6: initiate_self_privacy_purge
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.initiate_self_privacy_purge(
  p_session_token_hash TEXT,
  p_mode TEXT
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  operation_id UUID,
  generation INTEGER,
  cutoff_at TIMESTAMPTZ
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_session_id UUID;
  v_workspace_id UUID;
  v_user_id UUID;
  v_role TEXT;
  v_gen INTEGER;
  v_cutoff TIMESTAMPTZ := pg_catalog.now();
  v_op_id UUID := pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid();
BEGIN
  -- Authenticate through session token hash
  SELECT s.session_id, s.workspace_id, s.user_id, s.role
  INTO v_session_id, v_workspace_id, v_user_id, v_role
  FROM public.resolve_session_scope(p_session_token_hash) s;

  IF v_workspace_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required or invalid session token';
  END IF;

  IF p_mode NOT IN ('history_and_memory', 'account_closure') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid purge mode: % (must be history_and_memory or account_closure)', p_mode;
  END IF;

  -- Transaction-safe serialization: prevent concurrent generation allocation race per (workspace, user)
  PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    pg_catalog.hashtext(v_workspace_id::text),
    pg_catalog.hashtext(v_user_id::text)
  );

  -- Determine next generation atomically
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(c.generation), 0) + 1
  INTO v_gen
  FROM public.user_purge_cutoffs c
  WHERE c.workspace_id = v_workspace_id AND c.user_id = v_user_id;

  -- Record permanent cutoff
  INSERT INTO public.user_purge_cutoffs (
    workspace_id,
    user_id,
    cutoff_at,
    generation
  ) VALUES (
    v_workspace_id,
    v_user_id,
    v_cutoff,
    v_gen
  );

  -- Record purge operation
  INSERT INTO public.user_purge_operations (
    id,
    workspace_id,
    user_id,
    generation,
    cutoff_at,
    mode,
    status
  ) VALUES (
    v_op_id,
    v_workspace_id,
    v_user_id,
    v_gen,
    v_cutoff,
    p_mode,
    'pending'
  );

  -- Enqueue into outbox
  INSERT INTO public.worker_dispatch_outbox (
    workspace_id,
    topic,
    dedup_key,
    payload,
    status
  ) VALUES (
    v_workspace_id,
    'privacy_purge',
    format('purge:%s:%s:%s', v_workspace_id, v_user_id, v_gen),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'operation_id', v_op_id,
      'workspace_id', v_workspace_id,
      'user_id', v_user_id,
      'generation', v_gen,
      'mode', p_mode,
      'cutoff_at', v_cutoff
    ),
    'pending'
  );

  -- If account closure, revoke all active sessions for this user in this workspace
  IF p_mode = 'account_closure' THEN
    UPDATE public.sessions
    SET revoked_at = pg_catalog.now()
    WHERE workspace_id = v_workspace_id AND user_id = v_user_id AND revoked_at IS NULL;
  END IF;

  -- Emit audit record
  INSERT INTO public.audit_events (
    workspace_id,
    actor_user_id,
    action,
    target_type,
    target_id,
    payload
  ) VALUES (
    v_workspace_id,
    v_user_id,
    'privacy.purge_initiated',
    'user_purge_operation',
    v_op_id::text,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'generation', v_gen,
      'mode', p_mode
    )
  );

  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_op_id, v_gen, v_cutoff;
END;
$$;

-- Function 9: process_purge_batch_messages
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_purge_batch_messages(
  p_operation_id UUID,
  p_lease_token UUID,
  p_worker_id TEXT,
  p_batch_size INTEGER DEFAULT 100
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  processed_count INTEGER,
  has_more BOOLEAN
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_op RECORD;
  v_ids UUID[];
  v_processed INTEGER := 0;
  v_remaining BIGINT;
BEGIN
  -- Validate lease fencing
  SELECT *
  INTO v_op
  FROM public.user_purge_operations
  WHERE id = p_operation_id
    AND lease_token = p_lease_token
    AND lease_worker_id = p_worker_id
    AND status = 'running'
    AND lease_expires_at > pg_catalog.now();

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Purge fence violation: invalid or expired lease for operation %', p_operation_id;
  END IF;

  SELECT array_agg(sub.id)
  INTO v_ids
  FROM (
    SELECT m.id
    FROM public.conversation_messages m
    WHERE m.workspace_id = v_op.workspace_id
      AND m.user_id = v_op.user_id
      AND m.created_at <= v_op.cutoff_at
      AND m.content <> '[REDACTED_BY_PRIVACY_PURGE]'
    LIMIT p_batch_size
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  ) sub;

  IF v_ids IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(v_ids) > 0 THEN
    UPDATE public.conversation_messages
    SET content = '[REDACTED_BY_PRIVACY_PURGE]',
        metadata = '{}'::jsonb
    WHERE id = ANY(v_ids);

    v_processed := cardinality(v_ids);
    UPDATE public.user_purge_operations
    SET purged_messages_count = purged_messages_count + v_processed,
        updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
    WHERE id = p_operation_id;
  END IF;

  SELECT count(*)
  INTO v_remaining
  FROM public.conversation_messages
  WHERE workspace_id = v_op.workspace_id
    AND user_id = v_op.user_id
    AND created_at <= v_op.cutoff_at
    AND content <> '[REDACTED_BY_PRIVACY_PURGE]';

  IF v_remaining = 0 THEN
    UPDATE public.user_purge_operations
    SET checkpoint_messages_completed = TRUE,
        updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
    WHERE id = p_operation_id;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_processed, (v_remaining > 0);
END;
$$;

-- Section 4: Function 17 - inspect_private_conversation
-- ============================================================================
-- Fully qualified, unambiguous relation and column references throughout.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.inspect_private_conversation(
  p_session_token_hash TEXT,
  p_conversation_id UUID,
  p_justification TEXT,
  p_limit INTEGER DEFAULT 50,
  p_offset INTEGER DEFAULT 0
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id UUID,
  sequence_number INTEGER,
  sender_type TEXT,
  sender_id UUID,
  content TEXT,
  advisory_token_count INTEGER,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_session_id UUID;
  v_workspace_id UUID;
  v_user_id UUID;
  v_role TEXT;
  v_count INTEGER;
BEGIN
  -- Authenticate through session token hash
  SELECT sess.session_id, sess.workspace_id, sess.user_id, sess.role
  INTO v_session_id, v_workspace_id, v_user_id, v_role
  FROM public.resolve_session_scope(p_session_token_hash) AS sess;

  IF v_workspace_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required or invalid session token';
  END IF;

  -- Administrative role check
  IF v_role NOT IN ('owner', 'admin') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Permission denied: administrative inspection requires owner or admin role';
  END IF;

  -- Validate justification using pg_catalog.btrim
  IF p_justification IS NULL OR pg_catalog.length(pg_catalog.btrim(p_justification)) < 10 OR pg_catalog.length(p_justification) > 500 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Inspection justification must be between 10 and 500 characters';
  END IF;

  -- Validate conversation exists in same workspace with explicit table and column qualification
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.conversations AS conv
    WHERE conv.id = p_conversation_id AND conv.workspace_id = v_workspace_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Conversation % not found in authenticated workspace', p_conversation_id;
  END IF;

  -- Count rows to be returned with explicit table and column qualification
  SELECT count(*)
  INTO v_count
  FROM (
    SELECT msg.id
    FROM public.conversation_messages AS msg
    WHERE msg.workspace_id = v_workspace_id
      AND msg.conversation_id = p_conversation_id
    ORDER BY msg.sequence_number ASC
    LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset
  ) AS sub;

  -- Emit mandatory audit event with actual returned counts (NO message content)
  INSERT INTO public.audit_events (
    workspace_id,
    actor_user_id,
    action,
    target_type,
    target_id,
    payload
  ) VALUES (
    v_workspace_id,
    v_user_id,
    'admin.inspection',
    'conversation',
    p_conversation_id::text,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'justification', pg_catalog.btrim(p_justification),
      'returned_count', v_count,
      'limit', p_limit,
      'offset', p_offset
    )
  );

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    msg.id,
    msg.sequence_number,
    msg.sender_type,
    msg.sender_id,
    msg.content,
    msg.advisory_token_count,
    msg.created_at
  FROM public.conversation_messages AS msg
  WHERE msg.workspace_id = v_workspace_id
    AND msg.conversation_id = p_conversation_id
  ORDER BY msg.sequence_number ASC
  LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset;
END;
$$;

  FROM public.assistant_stream_executions
  WHERE workspace_id = v_workspace_id
    AND user_id = v_user_id
    AND conversation_id = p_conversation_id
    AND idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key;

  IF FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'stream_id', v_existing.id,
      'status', v_existing.status,
      'user_message_id', v_existing.user_message_id,
      'assistant_message_id', v_existing.assistant_message_id,
      'version', v_existing.version,
      'idempotent_replay', true
    );
  END IF;

  -- Verify conversation is active and belongs to user
  SELECT id, status INTO v_conv
  FROM public.conversations
  WHERE id = p_conversation_id
    AND workspace_id = v_workspace_id
    AND user_id = v_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Conversation % not found or unauthorized', p_conversation_id;
  END IF;

  IF v_conv.status <> 'active' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot initiate stream on non-active conversation % (status: %)', p_conversation_id, v_conv.status;
  END IF;

  -- Append user message
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(msg.sequence_number) + 1, 0)
  INTO v_next_msg_seq
  FROM public.conversation_messages msg
  WHERE msg.workspace_id = v_workspace_id AND msg.conversation_id = p_conversation_id;

  v_user_message_id := pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid();

  INSERT INTO public.conversation_messages (
    id,
    workspace_id,
    conversation_id,
    user_id,
    sequence_number,
    sender_type,
    sender_id,
    content,
    metadata,
    created_at
  ) VALUES (
    v_user_message_id,
    v_workspace_id,
    p_conversation_id,
    v_user_id,
    v_next_msg_seq,
    'user',
    v_user_id,
    pg_catalog.btrim(p_user_content),
    '{}'::jsonb,
    pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
  );

  UPDATE public.conversations
  SET updated_at = pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
  WHERE id = p_conversation_id;

  -- Create stream execution row in 'queued' status
  v_stream_id := pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid();

  INSERT INTO public.assistant_stream_executions (
    id,
    workspace_id,
    conversation_id,
    user_id,
    idempotency_key,
    user_message_id,
    assistant_message_id,
    status,
    version,
    advisory_token_count,
    accumulated_content,
    started_at,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  ) VALUES (
    v_stream_id,
    v_workspace_id,
    p_conversation_id,
    v_user_id,
    p_idempotency_key,
    v_user_message_id,
    NULL,
    'queued',
    1,
    0,
    '',
    pg_catalog.clock_timestamp(),
    pg_catalog.clock_timestamp(),
    pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
  );

  -- Append initial context_ready event
  INSERT INTO public.assistant_stream_events (
    workspace_id,
    conversation_id,
    user_id,
    stream_id,
    sequence_number,
    event_type,
    payload,
    created_at
  ) VALUES (
    v_workspace_id,
    p_conversation_id,
    v_user_id,
    v_stream_id,
    0,
    'context_ready',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'user_message_id', v_user_message_id,
      'status', 'queued'
    ),
    pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
  );

  -- Emit stream initiated audit log
  INSERT INTO public.audit_events (
    workspace_id,
    actor_user_id,
    action,
    target_type,
    target_id,
    payload
  ) VALUES (
    v_workspace_id,
    v_user_id,
    'assistant.stream_initiated',
    'assistant_stream',
    v_stream_id::text,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'conversation_id', p_conversation_id,
      'user_message_id', v_user_message_id,
      'idempotency_key', p_idempotency_key
    )
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'stream_id', v_stream_id,
    'status', 'queued',
    'user_message_id', v_user_message_id,
    'assistant_message_id', NULL,
    'version', 1,
    'idempotent_replay', false
  );
END;
$$;

-- 3. finalize_assistant_stream
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finalize_assistant_stream(
  p_session_token_hash TEXT,
  p_stream_id UUID,
  p_expected_version INTEGER,
  p_duration_ms INTEGER
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_session_id UUID;
  v_workspace_id UUID;
  v_user_id UUID;
  v_role TEXT;
  v_stream RECORD;
  v_assistant_msg_id UUID;
  v_next_msg_seq INTEGER;
  v_next_event_seq INTEGER;
BEGIN
  -- Resolve session scope
  SELECT s.session_id, s.workspace_id, s.user_id, s.role
  INTO v_session_id, v_workspace_id, v_user_id, v_role
  FROM public.resolve_session_scope(p_session_token_hash) s;

  IF v_workspace_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required or invalid session token';
  END IF;

  -- Lock stream row FOR UPDATE
  SELECT * INTO v_stream
  FROM public.assistant_stream_executions
  WHERE id = p_stream_id
    AND workspace_id = v_workspace_id
    AND user_id = v_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Assistant stream % not found or unauthorized', p_stream_id;
  END IF;

  IF v_stream.version <> p_expected_version THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Concurrency conflict: expected version %, actual version %', p_expected_version, v_stream.version;
  END IF;

  IF v_stream.status <> 'streaming' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid Stream State Transition: Cannot finalize stream with status %', v_stream.status;
  END IF;

  IF pg_catalog.length(pg_catalog.btrim(v_stream.accumulated_content)) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot finalize stream with empty accumulated content';
  END IF;

  -- Lock conversation FOR UPDATE
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.conversations
  WHERE id = v_stream.conversation_id
    AND workspace_id = v_workspace_id
    AND user_id = v_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  -- Append assistant message
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence_number) + 1, 0)
  INTO v_next_msg_seq
  FROM public.conversation_messages
  WHERE workspace_id = v_workspace_id AND conversation_id = v_stream.conversation_id;

  v_assistant_msg_id := pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid();

  INSERT INTO public.conversation_messages (
    id,
    workspace_id,
    conversation_id,
    user_id,
    sequence_number,
    sender_type,
    sender_id,
    content,
    advisory_token_count,
    metadata,
    assistant_stream_id,
    created_at
  ) VALUES (
    v_assistant_msg_id,
    v_workspace_id,
    v_stream.conversation_id,
    v_user_id,
    v_next_msg_seq,
    'assistant',
    NULL,
    v_stream.accumulated_content,
    v_stream.advisory_token_count,
    jsonb_build_object('duration_ms', p_duration_ms),
    p_stream_id,
    pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
  );

  UPDATE public.conversations
  SET updated_at = pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
  WHERE id = v_stream.conversation_id;

  -- Append terminal done event
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence_number) + 1, 0)
  INTO v_next_event_seq
  FROM public.assistant_stream_events
  WHERE workspace_id = v_workspace_id AND stream_id = p_stream_id;

  INSERT INTO public.assistant_stream_events (
    workspace_id,
    conversation_id,
    user_id,
    stream_id,
    sequence_number,
    event_type,
    payload,
    created_at
  ) VALUES (
    v_workspace_id,
    v_stream.conversation_id,
    v_user_id,
    p_stream_id,
    v_next_event_seq,
    'done',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'assistant_message_id', v_assistant_msg_id,
      'total_tokens', v_stream.advisory_token_count,
      'duration_ms', p_duration_ms
    ),
    pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
  );

  -- Update stream row to completed
  UPDATE public.assistant_stream_executions
  SET status = 'completed',
    assistant_message_id = v_assistant_msg_id,
    completed_at = pg_catalog.clock_timestamp(),
    version = v_stream.version + 1,
    updated_at = pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
  WHERE id = p_stream_id;

  -- Emit stream completed audit record
  INSERT INTO public.audit_events (
    workspace_id,
    actor_user_id,
    action,
    target_type,
    target_id,
    payload
  ) VALUES (
    v_workspace_id,
    v_user_id,
    'assistant.stream_completed',
    'assistant_stream',
    p_stream_id::text,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'conversation_id', v_stream.conversation_id,
      'assistant_message_id', v_assistant_msg_id,
      'total_tokens', v_stream.advisory_token_count,
      'duration_ms', p_duration_ms
    )
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'stream_id', p_stream_id,
    'status', 'completed',
    'assistant_message_id', v_assistant_msg_id,
    'sequence_number', v_next_event_seq,
    'version', v_stream.version + 1
  );
END;
$$;

-- 1. recover_stale_assistant_stream
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recover_stale_assistant_stream(
  p_stream_id UUID
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_stream RECORD;
  v_new_version INTEGER;
  v_next_event_seq INTEGER;
BEGIN
  -- Row lock candidate stream FOR UPDATE
  SELECT * INTO v_stream
  FROM public.assistant_stream_executions
  WHERE id = p_stream_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Assistant stream % not found', p_stream_id;
  END IF;

  -- Re-check status post-lock: idempotent if already terminal
  IF v_stream.status NOT IN ('queued', 'streaming') THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'stream_id', p_stream_id,
      'recovered', false,
      'reason', 'Stream already in terminal state',
      'status', v_stream.status
    );
  END IF;

  -- Re-check age post-lock: must be >= 60 seconds
  IF pg_catalog.clock_timestamp() - v_stream.started_at < interval '60 seconds' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Stream % is not stale (elapsed: %)', p_stream_id, (pg_catalog.clock_timestamp() - v_stream.started_at);
  END IF;

  v_new_version := v_stream.version + 1;

  UPDATE public.assistant_stream_executions
  SET status = 'failed',
      completed_at = pg_catalog.clock_timestamp(),
      error_code = 'STREAM_TIMEOUT',
      version = v_new_version,
      updated_at = pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
  WHERE id = p_stream_id;

  -- Append single error event
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence_number) + 1, 0)
  INTO v_next_event_seq
  FROM public.assistant_stream_events
  WHERE workspace_id = v_stream.workspace_id AND stream_id = p_stream_id;

  INSERT INTO public.assistant_stream_events (
    workspace_id,
    conversation_id,
    user_id,
    stream_id,
    sequence_number,
    event_type,
    payload,
    created_at
  ) VALUES (
    v_stream.workspace_id,
    v_stream.conversation_id,
    v_stream.user_id,
    p_stream_id,
    v_next_event_seq,
    'error',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'error', 'STREAM_TIMEOUT',
      'message', 'Stream timed out after exceeding 60-second active threshold'
    ),
    pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
  );

  -- Emit single audit record
  INSERT INTO public.audit_events (
    workspace_id,
    actor_user_id,
    action,
    target_type,
    target_id,
    payload
  ) VALUES (
    v_stream.workspace_id,
    NULL,
    'assistant.stream_stale_recovered',
    'assistant_stream',
    p_stream_id::text,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'conversation_id', v_stream.conversation_id,
      'previous_status', v_stream.status,
      'error_code', 'STREAM_TIMEOUT',
      'duration_ms', EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pg_catalog.clock_timestamp() - v_stream.started_at)) * 1000
    )
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'stream_id', p_stream_id,
    'recovered', true,
    'status', 'failed',
    'version', v_new_version
  );
END;
$$;

-- ============================================================================
-- Section 3: Procedure claim_purge_continuation (Attempt-Accounted)
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_purge_continuation(
  p_operation_id UUID,
  p_continuation_token UUID,
  p_worker_id TEXT,
  p_lease_seconds INTEGER DEFAULT 300
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  lease_token UUID,
  lease_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  status TEXT
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
AS $$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE
  v_op RECORD;
  v_new_token UUID := pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid();
  v_expires TIMESTAMPTZ := pg_catalog.now() + (p_lease_seconds || ' seconds')::interval;
BEGIN
  IF p_worker_id IS NULL OR length(trim(p_worker_id)) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Worker identifier is required';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_op
  FROM public.user_purge_operations
  WHERE public.user_purge_operations.id = p_operation_id
    AND public.user_purge_operations.continuation_token = p_continuation_token
    AND public.user_purge_operations.continuation_pending = TRUE
    AND public.user_purge_operations.status = 'running'
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    -- Duplicate delivery or continuation already resolved: return empty
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- Terminal failure if attempts exhausted
  IF v_op.attempts >= v_op.max_attempts THEN
    UPDATE public.user_purge_operations
    SET status = 'failed',
        continuation_pending = FALSE,
        continuation_token = NULL,
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_worker_id = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        error_code = 'PURGE_MAX_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED',
        error_category = 'TRANSIENT_INFRASTRUCTURE',
        updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
    WHERE public.user_purge_operations.id = p_operation_id;

    INSERT INTO public.audit_events (
      workspace_id,
      actor_user_id,
      action,
      target_type,
      target_id,
      payload
    ) VALUES (
      v_op.workspace_id,
      v_op.user_id,
      'privacy.purge_failed',
      'user_purge_operation',
      p_operation_id::text,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'generation', v_op.generation,
        'mode', v_op.mode,
        'error_code', 'PURGE_MAX_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED',
        'error_category', 'TRANSIENT_INFRASTRUCTURE',
        'attempts', v_op.attempts
      )
    );

    RETURN QUERY SELECT NULL::uuid, NULL::timestamptz, 'failed'::text;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- Atomically increment attempts and issue fresh lease
  UPDATE public.user_purge_operations
  SET attempts = public.user_purge_operations.attempts + 1,
      continuation_pending = FALSE,
      continuation_token = NULL,
      lease_token = v_new_token,
      lease_worker_id = p_worker_id,
      lease_expires_at = v_expires,
      updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
  WHERE public.user_purge_operations.id = p_operation_id;

  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_new_token, v_expires, 'running'::text;
END;
$$;

-- ============================================================================
-- Section 4: Procedure claim_unrecovered_purge_continuations (Recovery Sweeper)
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_unrecovered_purge_continuations(
  p_worker_id TEXT,
  p_batch_size INTEGER DEFAULT 10,
  p_lease_extension_seconds INTEGER DEFAULT 300
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  operation_id UUID,
  workspace_id UUID,
  user_id UUID,
  generation INTEGER,
  mode TEXT,
  cutoff_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  continuation_sequence INTEGER,
  continuation_token UUID
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
AS $$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE
  v_expired_rec RECORD;
  v_token UUID;
  v_expires TIMESTAMPTZ := pg_catalog.now() + (p_lease_extension_seconds || ' seconds')::interval;
BEGIN
  IF p_worker_id IS NULL OR length(trim(p_worker_id)) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Worker identifier is required';
  END IF;

  FOR v_expired_rec IN
    SELECT *
    FROM public.user_purge_operations
    WHERE public.user_purge_operations.status = 'running'
      AND public.user_purge_operations.continuation_pending = TRUE
      AND public.user_purge_operations.lease_expires_at < pg_catalog.now()
    ORDER BY public.user_purge_operations.updated_at ASC
    LIMIT p_batch_size
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  LOOP
    IF v_expired_rec.attempts >= v_expired_rec.max_attempts THEN
      UPDATE public.user_purge_operations
      SET status = 'failed',
          continuation_pending = FALSE,
          continuation_token = NULL,
          lease_token = NULL,
          lease_worker_id = NULL,
          lease_expires_at = NULL,
          error_code = 'PURGE_MAX_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED',
          error_category = 'TRANSIENT_INFRASTRUCTURE',
          updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
      WHERE public.user_purge_operations.id = v_expired_rec.id;

      INSERT INTO public.audit_events (
        workspace_id,
        actor_user_id,
        action,
        target_type,
        target_id,
        payload
      ) VALUES (
        v_expired_rec.workspace_id,
        v_expired_rec.user_id,
        'privacy.purge_failed',
        'user_purge_operation',
        v_expired_rec.id::text,
        jsonb_build_object(
          'generation', v_expired_rec.generation,
          'mode', v_expired_rec.mode,
          'error_code', 'PURGE_MAX_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED',
          'error_category', 'TRANSIENT_INFRASTRUCTURE',
          'attempts', v_expired_rec.attempts
        )
      );
    ELSE
      v_token := pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid();
      UPDATE public.user_purge_operations
      SET attempts = public.user_purge_operations.attempts + 1,
          lease_token = v_token,
          lease_worker_id = p_worker_id,
          lease_expires_at = v_expires,
          updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
      WHERE public.user_purge_operations.id = v_expired_rec.id;

      operation_id := v_expired_rec.id;
      workspace_id := v_expired_rec.workspace_id;
      user_id := v_expired_rec.user_id;
      generation := v_expired_rec.generation;
      mode := v_expired_rec.mode;
      cutoff_at := v_expired_rec.cutoff_at;
      continuation_sequence := v_expired_rec.continuation_sequence;
      continuation_token := v_expired_rec.continuation_token;
      RETURN NEXT;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END;
$$;

-- ============================================================================
-- Section 5: Hardened complete_purge_operation
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_purge_operation(
  p_operation_id UUID,
  p_lease_token UUID,
  p_worker_id TEXT
)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
AS $$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE
  v_op RECORD;
BEGIN
  IF p_worker_id IS NULL OR length(trim(p_worker_id)) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Worker identifier is required';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_op
  FROM public.user_purge_operations
  WHERE public.user_purge_operations.id = p_operation_id
    AND public.user_purge_operations.lease_token = p_lease_token
    AND public.user_purge_operations.lease_worker_id = p_worker_id
    AND public.user_purge_operations.status = 'running'
    AND public.user_purge_operations.lease_expires_at > pg_catalog.now()
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Purge fence violation: invalid or expired lease for operation %', p_operation_id;
  END IF;

  -- Completion barrier: cannot complete if continuation is pending
  IF v_op.continuation_pending THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot complete purge operation %: continuation is currently pending', p_operation_id;
  END IF;

  -- Prerequisite checkpoint validation
  IF NOT (v_op.checkpoint_messages_completed AND v_op.checkpoint_conversations_completed AND v_op.checkpoint_memories_completed) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot complete purge operation %: prerequisite checkpoints incomplete (messages: %, conversations: %, memories: %)',
      p_operation_id, v_op.checkpoint_messages_completed, v_op.checkpoint_conversations_completed, v_op.checkpoint_memories_completed;
  END IF;

  -- Sole-owner account closure policy
  IF v_op.mode = 'account_closure' THEN
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.memberships
      WHERE workspace_id = v_op.workspace_id AND user_id = v_op.user_id AND role = 'owner'
    ) THEN
      IF (
        SELECT count(*) FROM public.memberships
        WHERE workspace_id = v_op.workspace_id AND role = 'owner' AND user_id <> v_op.user_id
      ) = 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot close account: user is the sole owner of workspace %. Transfer ownership or delete workspace first.', v_op.workspace_id;
      END IF;
    END IF;

    DELETE FROM public.memberships
    WHERE workspace_id = v_op.workspace_id AND user_id = v_op.user_id;

    UPDATE public.user_purge_operations
    SET checkpoint_membership_completed = TRUE

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bind_plan_step_policy_atomic(
  p_session_token_hash TEXT,
  p_plan_id UUID,
  p_step_id UUID,
  p_workspace_persona_id UUID,
  p_platform_preset_id TEXT,
  p_platform_preset_version INTEGER,
  p_registry_version TEXT,
  p_schema_identifier TEXT,
  p_action_name TEXT,
  p_action_class TEXT,
  p_risk_level TEXT,
  p_approval_mode TEXT,
  p_required_role TEXT,
  p_idempotency_required BOOLEAN,
  p_audit_required BOOLEAN,
  p_timeout_ms INTEGER,
  p_parameter_hash TEXT,
  p_effective_policy_hash TEXT,
  p_entitlement_revision_hash TEXT,
  p_baseline_version TEXT,
  p_override_version INTEGER
)
RETURNS UUID
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_auth_ws UUID;
  v_auth_user UUID;
  v_auth_role TEXT;
  v_policy_snapshot JSONB;
  v_binding_id UUID;
BEGIN
  SELECT s.workspace_id, s.user_id, s.role
  INTO v_auth_ws, v_auth_user, v_auth_role
  FROM public.resolve_session_scope(p_session_token_hash) s;

  IF v_auth_ws IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication failure: invalid, expired, or revoked session';
  END IF;

  PERFORM pg_catalog.set_config('app.workspace_id', v_auth_ws::text, true);
  PERFORM pg_catalog.set_config('app.user_id', v_auth_user::text, true);
  PERFORM pg_catalog.set_config('app.role', v_auth_role, true);
  PERFORM pg_catalog.set_config('app.session_token_hash', p_session_token_hash, true);

  -- Assert plan step exists and belongs to workspace
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.plan_steps
    WHERE workspace_id = v_auth_ws AND plan_id = p_plan_id AND id = p_step_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Plan step % for plan % not found in workspace %', p_step_id, p_plan_id, v_auth_ws;
  END IF;

  -- Construct policy snapshot strictly from trusted scalar procedure parameters
  v_policy_snapshot := jsonb_build_object(
    'actionName', p_action_name,
    'actionClass', p_action_class,
    'risk', p_risk_level,
    'approvalMode', p_approval_mode,
    'requiredRole', p_required_role,
    'idempotencyRequired', p_idempotency_required,
    'auditRequired', p_audit_required,
    'timeoutMs', p_timeout_ms,
    'baselineVersion', p_baseline_version,
    'overrideVersion', p_override_version,
    'schemaIdentifier', p_schema_identifier
  );

  INSERT INTO public.plan_step_policy_bindings (
    workspace_id, plan_id, step_id, workspace_persona_id, platform_preset_id,
    platform_preset_version, registry_version, schema_identifier, action_name,
    action_class, risk_level, approval_mode, required_role, idempotency_required,
    audit_required, timeout_ms, parameter_hash, effective_policy_hash,
    entitlement_revision_hash, policy_snapshot
  ) VALUES (
    v_auth_ws, p_plan_id, p_step_id, p_workspace_persona_id, p_platform_preset_id,
    p_platform_preset_version, p_registry_version, p_schema_identifier, p_action_name,
    p_action_class, p_risk_level, p_approval_mode, p_required_role, p_idempotency_required,
    p_audit_required, p_timeout_ms, p_parameter_hash, p_effective_policy_hash,
    p_entitlement_revision_hash, v_policy_snapshot
  ) RETURNING id INTO v_binding_id;

  RETURN v_binding_id;
END;
$$;

CREATE ROLE thaara_phone_guard NOLOGIN NOINHERIT NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION;

CREATE TABLE public.phone_inbound_principals(
 principal_id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.workspaces(id),
 owner_user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id),
 route_id text NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(route_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$'),
 token_hash text NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(token_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
 profile_fingerprint text NOT NULL CHECK(profile_fingerprint ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
 revision integer NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0),
 operations text[] NOT NULL CHECK(operations IN(ARRAY['callback'],ARRAY['completion'],ARRAY['callback','completion'])),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
 expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
 revoked_at timestamptz,
 CHECK(expires_at>created_at AND expires_at<=created_at+interval '30 days')
);
ALTER TABLE public.phone_inbound_principals ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.phone_inbound_principals FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON public.phone_inbound_principals FROM PUBLIC,thaara_app,thaara_worker,thaara_phone_ingest;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO thaara_phone_guard,thaara_phone_ingest;
GRANT SELECT ON public.phone_inbound_principals TO thaara_phone_guard;

-- Row-lock privilege only; WITH CHECK(false) prevents definer mutation of the grant or owner membership.
GRANT UPDATE(revoked_at) ON public.phone_inbound_principals TO thaara_phone_guard;
CREATE POLICY phone_principal_guard_read ON public.phone_inbound_principals FOR SELECT TO thaara_phone_guard USING(true);
CREATE POLICY phone_principal_guard_lock ON public.phone_inbound_principals FOR UPDATE TO thaara_phone_guard USING(true) WITH CHECK(false);
GRANT SELECT ON public.memberships TO thaara_phone_guard;
GRANT UPDATE(role) ON public.memberships TO thaara_phone_guard;
CREATE POLICY phone_principal_membership_read ON public.memberships FOR SELECT TO thaara_phone_guard USING(true);
CREATE POLICY phone_principal_membership_lock ON public.memberships FOR UPDATE TO thaara_phone_guard USING(true) WITH CHECK(false);
GRANT SELECT,INSERT ON public.phone_inbound_call_events TO thaara_phone_guard;

CREATE POLICY phone_principal_events_read ON public.phone_inbound_call_events FOR SELECT TO thaara_phone_guard
 USING(public.phone_inbound_scope_matches(workspace_id,owner_user_id));

CREATE POLICY phone_principal_events_insert ON public.phone_inbound_call_events FOR INSERT TO thaara_phone_guard
 WITH CHECK(public.phone_inbound_scope_matches(workspace_id,owner_user_id));
GRANT INSERT(workspace_id,actor_user_id,action,target_type,target_id,payload,created_at) ON public.audit_events TO thaara_phone_guard;

-- Assign definer ownership without making runtime a member or granting it direct table rights.
GRANT CREATE ON SCHEMA public TO thaara_phone_guard;
ALTER FUNCTION public.phone_inbound_resolve_grant(text,text,text) OWNER TO thaara_phone_guard;
ALTER FUNCTION public.phone_inbound_scope_matches(uuid,uuid) OWNER TO thaara_phone_guard;
ALTER FUNCTION public.phone_inbound_append_event(jsonb) OWNER TO thaara_phone_guard;
REVOKE CREATE ON SCHEMA public FROM thaara_phone_guard;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.phone_inbound_resolve_grant(text,text,text),public.phone_inbound_scope_matches(uuid,uuid),public.phone_inbound_append_event(jsonb) FROM PUBLIC,thaara_app,thaara_worker;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.phone_inbound_resolve_grant(text,text,text),public.phone_inbound_append_event(jsonb) TO thaara_phone_ingest;
COMMIT;
